NDT training in Port Arthur: how it works for Port Arthur employers and technicians

NDT training in Port Arthur is delivered by Atlantis NDT as ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based Level I, II and III courses in UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET, taught live online or onsite at your refinery, LNG site, shop or yard under ASNT Level III oversight. Certification is issued by your employer under its written practice after training hours, documented experience, general, specific and practical exams, and a vision test.

Port Arthur and the rest of the Golden Triangle, with Beaumont and Orange, form one of the densest inspection markets in North America. Three large refineries, petrochemical crackers and chemical plants in Port Arthur, Port Neches, Nederland and Groves, two LNG export projects under construction on the Sabine Pass side of the county, a working ship channel, and the fabrication and tank shops that serve all of them. Demand is spiky: a single turnaround can pull hundreds of technicians into a unit for weeks, then release them. That makes certification records, not just skills, the thing that decides who gets a badge at the gate.

Atlantis NDT does not run a classroom in Port Arthur or anywhere in Jefferson County. We serve Port Arthur employers and technicians by delivering theory live online and bringing practical training, exams and Level III documentation to your facility. This section adds the depth the overview above does not: a method-by-method map, the certification path in order, scheduling around turnarounds and storms, the Texas radiographer certification rules, and the questions Golden Triangle technicians ask most. Request a Port Arthur training quote; we usually reply within one business day.

ASNT Level I, II and III courses available in Port Arthur

Each course follows the SNT-TC-1A body of knowledge for the method and level and is aligned to the codes and owner specifications common in Gulf Coast refining and LNG construction.

MethodLevelsWhat Port Arthur employers use it forPrerequisite
Ultrasonic testing (UT)I, II, III prepThickness monitoring of piping circuits, shear-wave weld inspection on repairs and new construction, lamination checks, high-temperature thickness readingsLevel I: employer entry rules. Level II: Level I plus documented experience
Phased array UT (PAUT)II, III prepCorrosion mapping of vessels and piping, encoded weld inspection replacing RT during turnarounds, weld inspection on LNG piping and modulesConventional UT Level II expected first
Time-of-flight diffraction (TOFD)II, III prepThrough-wall sizing of flaws in thick reactor, drum and vessel weldsConventional UT Level II expected first
Radiographic testing (RT)I, II, III prepPiping weld radiography during turnarounds and construction, profile radiography for corrosion under insulationTexas radiographer certification required before working with sources
Magnetic particle testing (MT)I, IISurface cracks on carbon-steel welds, nozzle welds, structural steel and lifting equipmentNone for Level I; Level I plus experience for Level II
Liquid penetrant testing (PT)I, IIStainless and alloy piping, cryogenic stainless systems at LNG sites, overlay and cladding checksNone for Level I; Level I plus experience for Level II
Visual testing (VT)I, IIWeld visual acceptance, internal vessel and tank inspection, external piping condition surveysNone for Level I; Level I plus experience for Level II
Eddy current testing (ET)I, IIHeat-exchanger and air-cooler tube inspection, one of the busiest turnaround scopesNone for Level I; Level I plus experience for Level II

UT training covers sound propagation, probe selection, calibration, DAC and TCG, angle-beam weld scanning and flaw evaluation, with additional practice on thickness measurement over corroded and hot surfaces, which is the first job most new Port Arthur technicians are given. PAUT and TOFD cover focal laws, scan plans, encoded collection and analysis for technicians already strong in conventional UT, and are where Level IIs move up in value. RT covers exposure calculation, image quality, film and digital interpretation and code acceptance. ET in Port Arthur means tubing: exchanger bundles pulled during turnarounds. MT, PT and VT are the quickest entry points. Level III candidates prepare for the ASNT Basic and Method exams through ASNT Level III training.

SNT-TC-1A certification path in Port Arthur, step by step

Texas does not license NDT technicians by method (radiation safety for radiographers is a separate matter covered below). Your employer certifies you, in this order:

  1. Employer written practice. Sets training and experience hours, exams, grading, vision requirements, recertification and the responsible Level III.
  2. Classroom training. The formal training hours for your method and level, delivered live online, in an arranged cohort or onsite. Recommended minimums are summarised in our training requirements matrix.
  3. On-the-job experience. Supervised and documented hours in the method. Turnaround work counts and accumulates quickly because of the long shifts.
  4. General exam. Written questions on method principles.
  5. Specific exam. Written questions on your employer's procedures, equipment and codes, for example ASME Section V, Section VIII, B31.3 or owner specifications.
  6. Practical exam. Hands-on examination of flawed specimens, administered and graded by a Level III along with the written exams.
  7. Vision test. Near-vision acuity and colour contrast, annually.
  8. Certification. Issued by the employer and signed by the Level III.
  9. Recertification. On the interval the written practice sets; a new employer recertifies you under its own practice.

More detail: SNT-TC-1A training and certification.

Online, live-virtual or onsite NDT training for Port Arthur crews

  • Live online theory: instructor-led classroom hours in real time, which lets technicians keep working between turnarounds. See online NDT training.
  • Onsite at your facility: theory, practical and exams at your shop, yard or plant training room, using your equipment and specimens that match refinery and LNG work.
  • Blended: theory online, then a concentrated in-person practical and exam block. A practical exam cannot be taken remotely under any credible scheme.

Golden Triangle scheduling revolves around the turnaround calendar. Spring and autumn turnaround seasons pull every certified technician into the plants, so the most useful training windows are the weeks before a season starts, when companies are building crews and need new Level Is and Level IIs certified in time to badge. Hurricane season, June through November, can close plants and roads with little warning, so onsite blocks get a fallback online schedule. Ask about onsite training for your Port Arthur crew before turnaround season, or see corporate NDT training.

Where NDT technicians work in Port Arthur

Refining. Port Arthur hosts Motiva's refinery, the largest in North America, alongside Valero's and TotalEnergies' refineries. Their mechanical-integrity programmes run UT thickness on thousands of piping circuit points, PAUT corrosion mapping, RT and PAUT on repair welds, ET on exchanger bundles and VT inside vessels, with methods referenced to ASME Section V and construction and repair work to Section VIII and B31.3.

Petrochemicals. Crackers and chemical plants in Port Arthur, Port Neches, Nederland and Groves, including the ethylene cracker jointly owned by BASF and TotalEnergies, add furnace tube, exchanger and piping inspection with the same code base.

LNG export construction. Port Arthur LNG, being built by Bechtel for Sempra, and Golden Pass LNG at Sabine Pass bring new-construction inspection: RT and PAUT on process piping, PT on stainless cryogenic systems, and inspection of large storage tanks, which for LNG service are commonly built from 9 percent nickel steel. Across the Sabine River, Cheniere's Sabine Pass terminal in Cameron Parish adds maintenance work for crews willing to cross into Louisiana.

Marine, terminals and fabrication. The Sabine-Neches Waterway, the Port of Port Arthur, crude and product terminals, and pipe, tank and structural fabricators across Jefferson and Orange counties supply steady weld inspection to AWS D1.1, ASME and API construction standards, plus pipeline work to API 1104.

Radiographer certification in Texas. Texas is an NRC Agreement State, and industrial radiography is licensed by the Texas Department of State Health Services Radiation Control Program under 25 TAC §289.255. Texas certifies industrial radiographers itself: a trainee needs a DSHS-issued trainee status card, a radiation safety course meeting the rule, and documented supervised on-the-job training under a radiographer trainer before sitting for certification, and Texas accepts certifications from certain recognised entities through a reciprocity process. This is entirely separate from SNT-TC-1A certification in RT. Our RT courses teach the method and interpretation; they do not replace DSHS radiographer certification. Louisiana, next door, is also an Agreement State with its own rules, so check reciprocity before crossing the river.

What local employers ask for. Documented Level II in UT and at least one other method, PAUT for higher-value roles, a current vision test, TWIC and plant safety credentials, and availability for turnaround rotations. Some local employers also ask for API 510, 570 or 653 inspector certification, CWI or CSWIP 3.1 at EPC sites; Atlantis does not train for those schemes. For pay context, see our NDT salary guide.

Level III services and written practices for Port Arthur NDT companies

Golden Triangle NDT companies scale up and down with the turnaround calendar, and that is exactly when certification records slip: new hires certified in a hurry, exams without complete answer keys, vision tests that lapse mid-season. Owner audits find these gaps. Atlantis reviews or writes your NDT written practice to the current SNT-TC-1A edition, provides outsourced Level III services for exams, procedure approval and certification, writes method procedures to your owners' specifications, and audits certification files before a turnaround starts. Book a Level III consultation for your Port Arthur company. Background: SNT-TC-1A training and certification.

Practise before the practical exam

Practical NDT, our 3D simulator, lets trainees practise 12 methods across five environments, including an oil and gas site and a storage tank, which mirror refinery and terminal work closely. It helps new technicians rehearse set-up and scan sequences between sessions. It is practice only and does not replace the practical exam on real specimens.

Your instructor

Programmes are led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III and founder of Atlantis NDT, who oversees course content, examinations and Level III sign-off for Atlantis cohorts delivered online and onsite.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Port Arthur

How do I get NDT certified in Port Arthur?

Be hired or sponsored by an NDT employer, complete the training and supervised experience its written practice requires, pass the general, specific and practical exams given by a Level III, and pass a vision test. Your employer then certifies you.

Can I take NDT training online in Texas?

Yes for the classroom portion, where your employer's written practice accepts live online delivery. The practical training and practical exam must be in person on real specimens.

How long does UT Level 2 training take?

It depends on the training and experience hours your employer's written practice sets and on your existing documented experience. See the training requirements matrix. Turnaround work can build experience hours faster than normal day work.

Do I need a license for radiography in Texas?

Yes, for working with radiation sources. Texas DSHS certifies industrial radiographers and requires trainees to hold a trainee status card, complete a qualifying radiation safety course and supervised on-the-job training, and then be certified. This is separate from SNT-TC-1A certification in RT.

What does NDT training cost in Port Arthur?

We quote on request, based on method, level, group size, delivery mode and whether exams and Level III support are included. Cohort and onsite quotes come back within one business day.

Is ASNT certification recognised by Port Arthur employers?

Yes. SNT-TC-1A is the standard basis for employer certification in Gulf Coast refining and petrochemicals. Each employer recertifies new hires under its own written practice, sometimes with owner-specific exams.

Which method gets me hired fastest in the Golden Triangle?

UT thickness and VT are the most common entry roles, followed by MT and PT. ET on exchanger tubing is a strong specialism for turnaround work. PAUT is the step up once your conventional UT is solid.

Can you certify a crew before turnaround season?

Yes, if we plan early. Training and experience requirements cannot be compressed, so start well before badging deadlines. Plan a pre-turnaround training block in Port Arthur.

Do you train onsite in Beaumont and Orange as well?

Yes. Onsite delivery covers the whole Golden Triangle and the wider Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coast.

Do you offer API 510, 570, 653 or CSWIP training?

No. Atlantis training is ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based only. Some Port Arthur employers ask for those credentials, earned through their own separate schemes.

Does PAUT replace radiography at Port Arthur plants?

Increasingly it supplements or replaces RT on welds where owner specifications allow, which reduces radiation exclusion zones during turnarounds. Owners decide when PAUT is acceptable.

Can my company outsource its Level III?

Yes, and many Golden Triangle companies do. Tell us your headcount and methods when you request a quote.
